Name: Totto's Capybaras for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
'ello 'ello! Happy holidays and all that!

TBH this one was just a search whim to see if anyone had made capybaras for SDV, cuz...I like capybaras. And Totto [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11864]DID[/url]! And permissions were open! So, now  you can have capybaras as a farm animal!

Capybaras come in 5 varieties﻿. They live in barns and will produce green and white algae. They DO NOT swim...yet. I plan to integrate that as a feature in the future for happier capybaras. 

Enjoy!
